attentionQuiet: No activity from the session for {mins} minutes. It may still be working (e.g. a long model response), or it may be stuck — stop it if it should have finished.
attentionLongTool: {tool} has been running for {mins} minutes. Fine if it is a long job; stop the session if it should have finished.
attentionUnresponsive: The session bridge has not responded for {mins} minutes (not even its heartbeat). It may be frozen — stop the session if it doesn't recover.
attentionNotStarted: The session has not started after {secs} seconds. Stop it and try again if it doesn't come up.
attentionPermissionWaiting: A permission request for {tool} has been waiting for your answer for {mins} minutes. The session is paused until you answer or stop it.
attentionUnmonitored: No activity from the session for {mins} minutes, and this session can't report whether it is still alive. It may be working or stuck — stop it if it should have finished.
attentionInputStalled: The session is not reading its input (a message to it has been waiting). It may be busy or stuck — stop the session if it doesn't recover.

queueHeldCancelled: The turn was cancelled, so the queued messages were not sent.
queueHeldBudget: The budget is exceeded, so the queued messages were not sent. Sending one asks you to confirm.

fork.confirmMessage:
A new session starts with this session's whole conversation and its settings (engine, model, response style, MCP servers). This session stays as it is.

Files are not copied or restored: the new session works on the project's files as they are now.
fork.confirmMessageHere:
A new session starts with this session's conversation up to the end of this answer, and its settings (engine, model, response style, MCP servers). This session stays as it is.

Files are not copied or restored: the new session works on the project's files as they are now, not as they were at this turn. To take the files back, use Rewind.
fork.doneWithoutConversation: Forked, but the agent cannot carry on this conversation (its engine session is gone): the new session shows the history and starts afresh.
fork.fromTitle: Open the session this one was forked from
fork.fromGone: Forked from a session no longer listed
fork.fromGoneTitle: That session is in the Trash or was deleted.
